$comment: Config for the AI SEO/GEO automation pipeline. The knowledge base (source of truth) lives in Notion — see knowledgeBase below. seedKeywords + competitors mirror the Notion KB; edit them in Notion and re-sync.

section.$comment: SEO auto-articles are the 'news' content stream: written to content/news/, served at /[locale]/news/[slug], and listed alongside hand-written issues on the unified /news hub.
